title: Bookmark Research 0.2.0 source and coverage audit
privacy: All 207 original URLs and original bookmark contexts remain only in the local inventory. Public rows omit private/account/file URLs and private titles, remove tracking parameters, and preserve source fingerprints. No private notes or credentials are copied.

coverage.interpretation: Excerpt availability is not factual verification, identity verification, completeness, or an independently replicated benchmark result.

design_decisions.D1: Explicit provider adapters and provenance-preserving MCP aggregation.
design_decisions.D2: Three research workflows, with host-led iterative search and durable deep-research sessions.
design_decisions.D3: Source review, exact stored quotes, claim withdrawal, conflict handling, and report integrity.
design_decisions.D4: Scoped bookmark references and a minimal local context manifest; no automatic remote upload or source write-back.
design_decisions.D5: Native host installation plus a thin, verifiable CLI and shared runtime.
design_decisions.D6: Separate deterministic correctness, live provider reliability, and research quality evaluation.
design_decisions.D7: Distinguish resumable local sessions from authenticated provider-native asynchronous research jobs.
